name: BFMXR
author: Elliot
tagline: bfxr.net's sound effects on the FM-1
description: Make bfxr.net's game sound effects on the FM-1: pick a kind of sound (coin, laser, explosion, powerup, hit, jump, blip, random), mutate it, edit all 32 of bfxr's parameters, and play it from the keys. ENV opens bfxr.net's other synths: Whooshr, Choirr, Breathr, Birdr, Bouncr, Swarmr, Machinr, Crittr, Zappr, Signlr, Pluckr, Rustlr, Squishr, Clonkr, Boomr, Fractr, Riftr, Glitchr, Jinglr, Transfxr, Footsteppr and Mixr. SEQ opens a 4-track, 16-step sequencer for your saved sounds.
credits: The sound engines, generators and synths are bfxr2 by Stephen Lavelle (MIT), from Thomas Vian's SfxrSynth (Apache-2.0), on fm1-base by Charles Vestal (MPL-2.0).
